description: Implementation of the AlertService interface for managing alerts in the OpenMRS platform, including methods for saving, retrieving, purging alerts, and notifying super users.

classes.name: AlertServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing AlertService, providing alert management functionalities in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setAlertDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO used for alert persistence.

methods.name: saveAlert
methods.description: Saves an alert, assigning default creator and timestamp if necessary, and ensures all recipients are linked.

methods.name: getAlert
methods.description: Retrieves an alert by its unique ID.

methods.name: getAllActiveAlerts
methods.description: Fetches all active (unread and unexpired) alerts for a given user.

methods.name: getAlertsByUser
methods.description: Fetches all alerts for a user, defaulting to authenticated user if none provided.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves alerts for a user with options to include read and/or expired alerts.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves all alerts for all users.

methods.name: notifySuperUsers
methods.description: Creates an alert notification for all superuser roles with error message and optional stack trace.
